user.title: Connect to Housecairn
user.description: Create an API token in Housecairn with the `read` scope, bound to the home to show. Home Assistant calls Housecairn with this token; Housecairn never receives a Home Assistant token.

data_description.api_token: Starts with hc_. It is stored in this configuration entry only.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave on unless the certificate is one you trust and Home Assistant does not.

home.title: Choose the home
home.description: This token is bound to several homes. Each home is added on its own; add the next one by setting up the integration again.

reauth_confirm.title: New token for {home}
reauth_confirm.description: Housecairn refused the token: it has expired, was revoked, or is no longer bound to this home. Create a new token with the `read` scope, bound to this home.

error.invalid_url: Enter an http or https address, without query or credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Housecairn could not be reached at this address.
error.ssl_error: The TLS certificate of the server was refused.
error.invalid_auth: Housecairn refused the token: it is invalid, expired or revoked.
error.insufficient_scope: The token does not have the `read` scope.
error.no_homes: The token is not bound to any home.
error.home_locked: This home requires signing in through a sign-in provider; an API token cannot open it.
error.wrong_home: The token is not bound to this home.

home_locked.message: This home requires signing in through a sign-in provider; an API token cannot open it.
